largedef_radius_ratio — DRIVE tacdome op

• Data kinds: signal × scalar → signal

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.largedef_radius_ratio(d, p: 'float', method: 'str' = 'quadrature') (to call the implementation directly, import tacdome; tacdome.largedef_radius_ratio(d, p: 'float', method: 'str' = 'quadrature'); from the registry, opsdrive.get("largedef_radius_ratio"))

Usage

Contact-radius ratio a/a_L under large deformation (Eq. 4) = (1/p)·B_d(1/p, 3/2)·d^{−1/p}/√(1 − d) = ∫₀¹ √((1 − d·uᵖ)/(1 − d)) du.

method="quadrature" (default): the integral on the right by composite Gauss–Legendre clustered toward 1. "beta": via the continued fraction of the incomplete beta, exactly as the original form (a separate path, for cross-checking). p = ∞ (flat punch) is the incompressible radial stretch 1/√(1 − d). As d → 0 it is 1 + d·p/(2(p+1)). The closed forms for p = 1 and 2 are (2/(3d))(1 − (1 − d)^{3/2})/√(1 − d) and [√(1−d)/2 + atan2(√d, √(1−d))/(2√d)]/√(1 − d). Raises ValueError: d outside [0, 1), p out of range, misspelled method.
